purpose: Keep generated PocketBase and local code-graph databases out of the dev-workflow commit gate.
bugFix: The ready-to-commit gate no longer mistakes local generated databases for production source changes.
rootCause: Generated database files were neither tracked nor ignored, so the bugfix knowledge gate demanded annotations for binary artifacts.
fix: Ignore pb_data/ and .zettly-code/ as local generated state.

purpose: Describe this sidecar record itself so the bugfix knowledge gate accepts the annotation file it just read.
bugFix: The annotation file is no longer treated as an unannotated modified file.
rootCause: A newly created sidecar JSON is itself a changed non-commentable file subject to the same gate.
fix: Include a self-referencing sidecar record in the same file.

purpose: Version metadata for the v3.1.4 release.
bugFix: Source, npm and website versions now agree at 3.1.4.
rootCause: The repository was four commits ahead of the published 3.1.3 release.

bugFix: Lockfile matches the published source version.
rootCause: npm version bump updates the lockfile alongside package.json.

purpose: Generated public website catalog for v3.1.4.
bugFix: Public catalog reports the same version as the released package.
Website use cases no longer advertise the old release.
rootCause: Fleet release version literals were pinned to 3.1.3.
fix: Regenerate and update version literals to 3.1.4.
